metrics.basis: (operating cash flow - absolute capital expenditure) / revenue, all from one year-aligned fiscal year; revenue at or below zero is not meaningful

metrics.label: Interest coverage (operating income / interest expense)
metrics.basis: operating income / interest expense as filed (an expense is positive), all from one year-aligned fiscal year; interest expense at or below zero is not meaningful, an operating loss gives a negative ratio

metrics.label: Operating income + D&A (EBITDA proxy)
metrics.basis: operating income + depreciation and amortization as filed (an add-back is positive), all from one year-aligned fiscal year; negative depreciation and amortization is not meaningful

metrics.label: Effective tax rate
metrics.basis: income tax expense (a benefit is negative) / pretax income from continuing operations, all from one year-aligned fiscal year; not clamped, pretax income at or below zero is not meaningful

metrics.label: ROIC (operating income after effective tax / period-end invested capital)
metrics.basis: operating income x (1 - income tax expense / pretax income), all from one year-aligned fiscal year, / (stockholders' equity + debt - cash and cash equivalents) at that fiscal year end; an effective tax rate outside 0-100% or invested capital at or below zero is not meaningful
